title: AWCS VictoriaMetrics Metrics Readiness
description: Exposes available metrics without fabricating AWCS endpoint data, and clearly identifies missing instrumentation. Datasources: VictoriaMetrics (existing non-prod instance, Prometheus-compatible) and Tempo (fallback panel). As of the investigation behind this dashboard, custom_http_request_* and http_server_* metric families exist globally in VictoriaMetrics but no series were found for KEYSTONE_TENANT_ID="np-edps-aks" AWCS services. Panels are kept visible (not deleted) so they activate automatically once instrumentation lands — re-run each query after deployment to confirm.

options.content:
**Verified as of the last investigation:** the following metric families exist globally in this VictoriaMetrics instance, but **no series were found** for `KEYSTONE_TENANT_ID="np-edps-aks"` scoped to AWCS McLeod services:

- `custom_http_request_count`
- `custom_http_request_bucket`
- `custom_http_request_sum`
- `http_server_request_duration_seconds_count`
- `http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket`
- `http_server_request_duration_seconds_sum`
- `http_server_active_requests`

Panels 1–3 below are expected to render **No data** until AWCS emits these series. This is a readiness dashboard, not a populated endpoint-saturation dashboard — re-test each query after instrumentation changes rather than substituting another tenant's data.

panels.title: AWCS Endpoint Request Rate  ⚠ No AWCS series found as of last test
panels.description: Endpoint request rate for AWCS services. This query was tested against non-prod VictoriaMetrics and returned no AWCS data. Keep the panel visible with a clear 'No AWCS metrics currently available' annotation rather than substituting another tenant's data. Datasource: VictoriaMetrics (non-prod).

defaults.noValue: No AWCS metrics currently available — pending instrumentation

panels.title: AWCS Endpoint P95 Latency  ⚠ No AWCS series found as of last test
panels.description: 95th percentile endpoint latency for AWCS services. This requires AWCS request-duration histogram series. The metric family exists globally, but no matching AWCS series were found during testing. Datasource: VictoriaMetrics (non-prod).

defaults.noValue: No AWCS metrics currently available — pending instrumentation

panels.title: AWCS In-Flight Requests  ⚠ No AWCS series found as of last test
panels.description: Shows active HTTP requests for AWCS services if exported. No matching AWCS series were found during testing. Datasource: VictoriaMetrics (non-prod).

defaults.noValue: No AWCS metrics currently available — pending instrumentation

panels.title: Metrics Availability Status  ⚠ Expected 0 as of last test
panels.description: Reports whether VictoriaMetrics currently has any AWCS series for the tenant and service filter. A zero result means endpoint saturation metrics are not currently available in VictoriaMetrics. Datasource: VictoriaMetrics (non-prod).

defaults.noValue: 0 series — no AWCS metrics available yet

panels.title: Tempo Span-Based Endpoint Activity
panels.description: Fallback investigation panel using Tempo spans while VictoriaMetrics endpoint metrics are unavailable. This provides trace-level endpoint activity but is not a replacement for time-series request-rate, saturation, or percentile metrics. Datasource: Tempo (non-prod).
